mapper.select: SELECT A.DMINSTT_CD , A.BDGT_YR , A.ASIGN_AMT , COALESCE(SUM(CAST(REPLACE(P.REQ_AMT, ',', '') AS NUMERIC)), 0) AS EXCUT_AMT , A.ASIGN_AMT - COALESCE(SUM(CAST(REPLACE(P.REQ_AMT, ',', '') AS NUMERIC)), 0) AS RMND_AMT FROM TB_BDGT_ASIGN A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PYMNT P ON P.DMINSTT_CD = A.DMINSTT_CD AND P.PYMNT_STTS_CD = '30' WHERE A.DMINSTT_CD = #{dminsttCd} AND A.BDGT_YR = COALESCE(#{bdgtYr}, '2026') GROUP BY A.DMINSTT_CD, A.BDGT_YR, A.ASIGN_AMT
